title: Sectioned master plan index and selective retrieval
problem: Project manager should not load whole master plan by default. Need sectioned plan with explicit titles and selective read/expand behavior.
fullPrompt: Implement section-based master plan model: each section has stable id, title, short summary, detail body, owner thread, status, and last-updated metadata. Add endpoints and storage access patterns for list (summary-only), detail-by-section, and selective update. Ensure PM default read path returns only section headers/summaries + unread proposal signals, with explicit expand for detail.
doneCriteria: Section index + selective retrieval works without full-plan load; schema documented and integrated into PM workflow.
reportBack: Append summary to docs/master-control.md with schema and retrieval behavior details.
modelReason: Narrow and well-scoped task where fast iteration is enough.
